headline: ADNOC Logistics Vessel Attacked in Strait of Hormuz
summary: ADNOC Logistics & Services confirmed one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on November 17, leaving one crew member unaccounted for amid escalating tanker risks.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil transit chokepoint. Disruptions or security threats there directly threaten global crude supplies.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Security threats and attacks on commercial vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz add a geopolitical risk premium to crude benchmarks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Escalating security threats and an attack on a commercial tanker in the Strait of Hormuz raised concerns over potential crude shipment interruptions.
